catalog.title: Driving
catalog.description: ГТП inspections, mechanics who diagnose by ear, KAT patrols, mountain passes, LPG queues, and one deeply opinionated used car.
catalog.contentNotice: Dangerous-driving anecdotes, police encounters, breakdowns, mild bribery-adjacent humor, and financial loss.

strings.driving.campaign.description: Inspection stickers, mechanic trust, police, parking, weather, parts, towing, and one very opinionated car — Bulgaria's national relationship, dramatized.
strings.driving.campaign.title: Driving
strings.driving.driving.choice_ask_another_opini: Ask another opinion and test it on the road
strings.driving.driving.choice_believe_him: Believe him and build a repair plan
strings.driving.driving.choice_ignore_warning: Ignore the warning and plan an exit
strings.driving.driving.choice_turn_up_music: Turn up the music and head for the road
strings.driving.driving.text: You pass the ГТП inspection by four minutes and one understanding technician. Five minutes later the dashboard lights up like a name-day table. The mechanic says it was 'already like that,' which is, legally speaking, a diagnosis.
strings.driving.ending_abandoned_project.text:
The Abandoned Project

You hand over the keys and walk home lighter than you have felt in months.
strings.driving.ending_became_a_taxi.text:
A Second Career, Unlicensed

A neighbour offers good money for occasional airport runs. Within a month the car has a fixed rate, a regular clientele, and opinions about which terminal is faster.
The Pass Remembers You

Word of the storm crossing spreads through every roadside kafene between here and Kazanlak. Strangers now recognize the car before they recognize you.
strings.driving.ending_collector_item.text:
The Accidental Collector

The police warning turns out to confirm the model's rare specification. What was merely old becomes collectible overnight.
strings.driving.ending_endless_repairs.text:
The Perpetual Repair

Every repaired sound reveals a quieter one beneath it. You learn to budget by frequency, like a very small orchestra.
strings.driving.ending_impounded_at_the_border.t:
Detained at Kapitan Andreevo

A customs officer takes one long look at the paperwork, one longer look at the car, and directs you to a special lane reserved for cars with 'interesting histories.' You miss the ferry, the meeting, and most of your optimism.
strings.driving.ending_insurance_fraud_temptatio:
The Offer You Didn't Take, Mostly

A man at the yard suggests, quietly, that the car could 'have an accident' somewhere more profitable. You decline. The car, offended on principle, breaks down anyway, for free, out of spite.
strings.driving.ending_mechanic_becomes_family.t:
You Are Now Basically Related

The mechanic starts calling you at rakia hour to report on the car unprompted. You are invited to his daughter's wedding. The car, somehow, runs better after.
strings.driving.ending_one_more_repair_actually_:
The Hammer, Reconsidered

Against every piece of advice you gave yourself, you approve one final repair. It works. It simply, quietly works, and you drive home wondering what exactly you learned from any of this.
strings.driving.ending_reliable_car.text:
The Reliable Car

It starts in winter, stops on purpose, and asks nothing more dramatic of you than fuel.
strings.driving.ending_scrapped_for_parts.text:
Distributed Among the Living

The scrap dealer takes it apart with visible respect. Within a year you spot its wing mirror on a taxi, its seats in a garage sofa, and its horn, unmistakably, on a tractor.
strings.driving.ending_sold_car.text:
Sold Before Sunset

You describe every fault honestly. The buyer calls them character and transfers the money anyway.
strings.driving.ending_sold_to_a_tourist.text:
A German Bought It, Somehow

A tourist admires the car's 'character' outside a café in Veliko Tarnovo and pays cash on the spot, no questions, no test drive. You do not correct his optimism.
strings.driving.ending_the_part_never_arrives.te:
Still Waiting on the Part From Rado

Rado swears it left the warehouse Tuesday. It is now several Tuesdays later. The car sits under a tarp, technically a project, spiritually a monument.
strings.driving.ending_trusting_the_mechanic.tex:
Trust the Hammer

Your original mechanic buys the project, fixes it with one decisive strike of something, and refuses to explain what.
strings.driving.escape_route_1.text: A parking space narrows around the car while five neighbours direct you from five entirely incompatible angles.
strings.driving.escape_route_2.text: The warning light becomes a warning noise halfway to the market, and a warning smell somewhere near the ring road.
strings.driving.escape_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.driving.escape_route_3.favour_fail: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.driving.escape_route_3.text: A tow truck arrives with the unhurried calm of a driver who has met this exact car before.
strings.driving.escape_route_4.ending_insurance_: The Offer You Didn't Take, Mostly
strings.driving.escape_route_4.text: At the yard, the insurer, a marketplace buyer, and a scrap dealer offer three sincerely different definitions of value.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_1a.text: The receipt proves the bay was legal yesterday, which turns out to be the strongest form of legality this street recognizes.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_1b.proceed: Leave before anyone writes a note
strings.driving.escape_route_event_1b.text: A mirror acquires a neat scar, and the neighbour acquires a complete, unshakeable theory about how.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_2a.proceed: Ask for one last repair estimate
strings.driving.escape_route_event_2a.text: The tow driver knows an insurance assessor who answers on the very first ring — a small miracle nobody mentions twice.
strings.driving.escape_route_event_2b.proceed: List the car as a project
strings.driving.escape_route_event_2b.text: The online listing receives nineteen offers, all of them opening with 'final price?'
strings.driving.repair_route_1.listen: Ask the mechanic to prioritize safety
strings.driving.repair_route_1.text: The mechanic hands you a handwritten repair order in three parts: brakes first, the mystery noise second, your dignity whenever the parts arrive from Plovdiv.
strings.driving.repair_route_2.improvise: Order parts before checking the policy
strings.driving.repair_route_2.text: Insurance and vehicle tax occupy neighbouring windows whose lunch breaks overlap with suspicious, possibly deliberate precision.
strings.driving.repair_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.driving.repair_route_3.favour_fail: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.driving.repair_route_3.text: A parts dealer locates the exact component in a warehouse described only as 'past the roundabout, ask for Rado'.
strings.driving.repair_route_4.ending_the_part_n: Still Waiting on the Part From Rado
strings.driving.repair_route_4.text: The car returns to the lift for the final verdict: restore it properly, keep negotiating with entropy, or admit the project now owns you.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_1a.text: The inspection sheet proves the warning light appeared after the test — earning an unusually respectful shrug from the inspector.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_1b.text: The light turns off by itself and buys you six hours of false, blissful peace.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_2a.proceed: Follow the directions to Rado's warehouse
strings.driving.repair_route_event_2a.text: Rado recognizes the mechanic by voice alone and finds an original part hiding under three dead alternators.
strings.driving.repair_route_event_2b.text: The almost-identical part fits perfectly, except for the one connector that defines the entire car.
strings.driving.road_route_1.text: A second mechanic diagnoses the weather, the fuel quality, and your entire relationship with the accelerator pedal.
strings.driving.road_route_2.improvise: Debate the meaning of the road sign
strings.driving.road_route_2.text: Rain turns the mountain pass into a practical exam no licensing office could legally administer, somewhere between Shipka and regret.
strings.driving.road_route_3.favour: Call in the favour you earned
strings.driving.road_route_3.favour_fail: No one owes you that favour yet.
strings.driving.road_route_3.text: Police stop you beside a fuel station where LPG, petrol, and coffee somehow share one single queue.
strings.driving.road_route_4.text: With the storm behind you, the car feels either proven or forgiven. The distinction matters considerably at the marketplace.
strings.driving.road_route_event_1.text: The day contributes its own amendment.
strings.driving.road_route_event_1a.text: The road test reveals a loose heat shield — a cheap, almost emotionally disappointing answer to six months of dread.
strings.driving.road_route_event_1b.text: A pothole silences the original noise and, generously, introduces two new ones.
strings.driving.road_route_event_2.text: A seeded interruption arrives on schedule.
strings.driving.road_route_event_2a.text: The officer notices the inspection receipt, softens considerably, and recommends a safer route down.
strings.driving.road_route_event_2b.text: The cheaper LPG station is open, but its card terminal is 'participating remotely' today — cash only, which means the ATM two villages back.
